lines.en: label utamaid5:
scene utamaidfive1
I arrive at the maid cafe and find that it’s actually kind of busy for some reason tonight.
lines.zh: 我到了女仆咖啡厅，发现今晚不知怎么的居然还挺热闹。

lines.en: So busy that I don’t even have to deal with the inner struggle about whether to ring the bell or not as Uta immediately notices my presence and greets me at the entrance.
lines.zh: 热闹到我连「到底要不要摇那个铃」的内心挣扎都省了——Uta 一眼就注意到了我，直接在门口迎了上来。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive2
: Maaaaaasteeeeeeer~
lines.zh: : Maaaaasteeeeeer~

lines.en: : Welcome baaaaaaack~
lines.zh: : Welcome baaaaaaack~

lines.en: : Are you crying right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在哭吗？

lines.en: : I’m just so...{i}sniff{/i}...happy to see you...
lines.zh: : 我只是太……{i}抽泣{/i}……太高兴见到您了……

lines.en: : It has nothing to do with how I’ve been on my feet for a million years...I’m totally fine...
lines.zh: : 这跟我站了一百万年一点关系都没有……我完全没事……

lines.en: : Why not take a break or something?
lines.zh: : 那你就休息一下什么的呗？

lines.en: scene utamaidfive3
: Ugh...Spoken like a true non-customer-servicey-person...
lines.zh: : 唉……真是典型的没干过服务业的人才会说的话……

lines.en: : I can’t just take a break when we’re this busy.
lines.zh: : 这么忙的时候我哪能说休息就休息啊。

lines.en: : We’re having a crazy sale thingy this weekend to try and bring in more customers-
lines.zh: : 这个周末我们在搞一场疯狂大促销，想多招揽点客人——

lines.en: : And, on top of that, I’ve gotta train a new maid as well. I’m beat. I didn’t even get to have lunch today.
lines.zh: : 而且除此之外，我还得带一个新来的女仆。我累死了。今天连午饭都没吃上。

lines.en: : Is that even allowed? Aren’t you a-
lines.zh: : 这也行？你不是——

lines.en: : Part-time employee? You bet your butt I am. But that doesn’t change how I’ve gotta step up when there are...steps that need to be...stepped up.
lines.zh: : 兼职员工？我当然是啦，这还用问。可这也不影响该我顶上的时候我就得顶上……该迈的步子总得有人去迈。

lines.en: : Or something.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : This is not the Uta-chan I know. That Uta-chan wouldn’t get so easily stumped by her own words.
lines.zh: : 这可不是我认识的那个 Uta 酱。那个 Uta 酱才不会因为自己说的话就这么轻易卡壳。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive4
: The Uta-chan you know and love is no more. She’s with her grandpa now.
lines.zh: : 您所熟知的、所喜爱的那个 Uta 酱已经不在了。她现在陪爷爷去了。

lines.en: : Can you stop bringing up your dead grandpa all the time, please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别老把你那个过世的爷爷挂在嘴边？

lines.en: : Alas. I miss him dearly.
lines.zh: : 唉。我好想他。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive5
: Hey. You wouldn’t wanna put on a uniform and help me out by any chance, would you?
lines.zh: : 话说。您该不会正好想换上制服来帮我一把吧？

lines.en: : That might be the worst thing anyone has ever asked of me.
lines.zh: : 这大概是有史以来别人对我提出过的最糟的要求。

lines.en: : So is that a no? Even though you love me to pieces?
lines.zh: : 所以是拒绝咯？哪怕您爱我爱得粉身碎骨？

lines.en: : There isn’t anyone I love enough to wear a costume like that.
lines.zh: : 这世上没有谁值得我为她穿上那种衣服。

lines.en: : Not even if it’s one I wore?
lines.zh: : 就算是我穿过的也不行？

lines.en: : You wouldn’t put it on and think something lewd like “Uta-chan’s beautiful, bare skin touched this fabric. I can’t contain myself!” or something like that?
lines.zh: : 您穿上它的时候，就不会冒出什么下流的念头，比如「Uta 酱那美丽裸露的肌肤碰过这块布料，我忍不住了！」之类的？

lines.en: : Okay, I’m definitely bad- but I’m not {i}that{/i} bad.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我确实挺下流的——但还没{i}那么{/i}下流。

lines.en: : Also, there is no chance in hell that something you wore would ever fit me.
lines.zh: : 而且你穿过的衣服，打死也不可能套得进我这身板。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive6
: That’s it. You and Io both hate me. She wouldn’t wear the costume either and she’d probably look even cuter in it than you would.
lines.zh: : 够了。你和 Io 都讨厌我。她也不肯穿那套衣服，而且她穿上搞不好比您还可爱。

lines.en: : I don’t think the “probably” is needed there. She’d look much better than me in a maid outfit.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那个「搞不好」纯属多余。她穿女仆装肯定比我好看多了。

lines.en: : Now Uta-chan’s friend is being praised instead of Uta-chan. What a horrible day.
lines.zh: : 现在被夸的居然是 Uta 酱的朋友，不是 Uta 酱。真是糟透了的一天。

lines.en: : Ah! Shit!
lines.zh: : 啊！糟了！

lines.en: : Um...U-Uta?...
: I hope we never have to do something like this sale ever again...
lines.zh: : 希望我们以后再也不用搞这种促销了……

lines.en: : Careful, Uta. You’re breaking character.
lines.zh: : 小心，Uta。你出戏了。

lines.en: : I hope we never have to do something like this sale ever again, Master...
lines.zh: : 希望我们以后再也不用搞这种促销了，Master……

lines.en: : Better. Hang in there.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。撑住。

lines.en: : Can I just take a seat wherever?
lines.zh: : 我随便找个位子坐就行吧？

lines.en: : Of course, Master...
lines.zh: : 当然可以，Master……

lines.en: scene utamaidfive7
: But...if you want my recommendation-
lines.zh: : 不过……如果您想听听我的推荐——

lines.en: : There’s this really cute girl over in the corner that would love your company if you’d be so obliged.
lines.zh: : 角落里坐着一位特别可爱的女孩，如果您愿意赏光，她一定很高兴有您作伴。

lines.en: : And she hasn’t even placed her order yet, so you’ll probably be served faster if you sit with her as well.
lines.zh: : 而且她还没点单呢，所以您要是跟她坐一起，上菜大概也会快些。

lines.en: : Beautiful girl?
lines.zh: : 漂亮的女孩？

lines.en: scene utamaidfive8
: Oh, Io is here.
lines.zh: : 哦，Io 在这儿啊。

lines.en: : That’s right, Master!
lines.zh: : 没错，Master！

lines.en: : The cute and cuddly bathhouse girl you know and love, Io Ichimonji. Slender, soft, and ripe for the plucking!
lines.zh: : 就是您熟悉又喜爱的那个软萌澡堂女孩，Io Ichimonji。苗条、柔软，正等着被人采摘呢！

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be upselling desserts and not actual human beings?
lines.zh: : 你不该是推销甜点吗，怎么推销起活人来？

lines.en: : If she’s going to auction me off, I’m gonna auction her off! This is war!
lines.zh: : 她既然要把我拍卖出去，那我就把她拍卖出去！这是战争！

lines.en: scene utamaidfive9
: Come on, Master. Don’t you think she looks all lonely over there by herself?
lines.zh: : 来嘛，Master。您不觉得她一个人坐那边看着挺孤单的吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure she’d love a little bit of company.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定她会喜欢有个人陪陪她。

lines.en: : Also, if you sit with her, I can kill a bunch of birds with a rock and have the new maid come out and take {i}both{/i} of your orders at once.
lines.zh: : 而且您跟她坐一起，我就能一石多鸟，让新来的女仆一次把你们{i}俩{/i}的单都点了。

lines.en: So it was just about efficiency...
lines.zh: 到头来还是为了效率啊……

lines.en: : I was planning on just testing things out with Io since she’s a friend of mine and won’t leave any bad reviews-
lines.zh: : 我本来打算只拿 Io 试试水，因为她是我朋友，不会给我留差评——

lines.en: : But two friends at the same time? This is a gold mine I can’t let slip away.
lines.zh: : 但两个朋友一起来？这简直是座金矿，我可不能白白放过。

lines.en: : What’s wrong? Why the silent treatment all of a sudden, Master?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？怎么突然不说话了，Master？

lines.en: : Does Io make you nervous?
lines.zh: : 是 Io 让您紧张了吗？

lines.en: : I kind of...you know.
lines.zh: : 我有点……你知道的。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive10
: Ah! Master!
lines.zh: : 啊！Master！

lines.en: : Were you upset because you wanted {i}me{/i} to be your maid, no matter what?
lines.zh: : 您该不会是因为想让{i}我{/i}当您的女仆、无论如何都想，所以才不高兴的吧？

lines.en: : You are the only maid that matters to me, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，唯一重要的女仆就是你，Uta 酱。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Even though your [niece] works here?
lines.zh: : 就算您的[niece]也在这儿工作？

lines.en: : Oh.
: Right...
lines.zh: : 对哦……

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I won’t tell her you like me more.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我不会告诉她您更喜欢我的。

lines.en: That’s really comforting to hear from a girl who introduced herself to the class with “I will probably let things about you slip on accident. Don’t hate me for it.”
lines.zh: 从一个当初在全班面前自我介绍时说「我大概会不小心把关于你的事说漏嘴，别因此恨我」的女孩嘴里听到这话，真是让人安心极了。

lines.en: : Thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢了……

lines.en: scene utamaidfive9
: You don’t need to worry, though, Master. I’ll be right there with the new girl.
lines.zh: : 不过您不用担心，Master。我会跟着新来的女孩一起过去。

lines.en: : I’ll shadow her while she takes your order so I can be sure she’s taking care of you just as well as I would.
lines.zh: : 她给您点单的时候我会在旁边盯着，好确保她把您照顾得跟我一样周到。

lines.en: : Well, maybe not {i}just{/i} as well. There’s no one that likes caring for you as much as your faithful Uta-chan does~
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许不是{i}完全{/i}一样周到。毕竟没有人比您忠诚的 Uta 酱更喜欢照顾您了~

lines.en: : God I love you.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我太爱你了。

lines.en: : Then go sit with Io and wait for me to come over there.
lines.zh: : 那您就去跟 Io 坐着，等我过去。

lines.en: : I’ll be back soon, kay? I’ve already kinda talked to you over here for too long.
lines.zh: : 我很快就回来，好吗？我在这儿已经跟您聊得有点太久了。

lines.en: : But this was the closest I had to a break all day, so at least I can be happy I got to spend it with you~
lines.zh: : 不过这已经是今天最接近休息的一会儿了，所以至少我还能庆幸，这段时间是跟您一起度过的~

lines.en: scene black
Uta winks at me, doing a twirl as she skips away to the kitchen.
lines.zh: Uta 朝我眨了下眼，转了个圈，蹦跳着往后厨去了。

lines.en: I need to squeeze past a few other customers who had pulled their chairs out a bit too far on my way to Io-
lines.zh: 去 Io 那边的路上，我得从几个把椅子拉得太靠外的客人中间挤过去——

lines.en: But I eventually make it there and...I guess I startle her as she jumps up in surprise the second I sit down.
lines.zh: 不过我总算挤到了，而且……我刚一坐下，她就被吓得跳了起来，看来是把她吓着了。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive11
: Oh my God...Hey.
lines.zh: : 我的天……嗨。

lines.en: : You scared the crap out of me.
lines.zh: : 你吓死我了。

lines.en: : I thought you were just some random person sitting down at the table with me for a second.
lines.zh: : 有那么一瞬间，我还以为是个陌生人一屁股坐到我桌边来了。

lines.en: : Hey Io. Independent as ever, I see.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Io。还是一如既往地独来独往啊。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive12
: Nahh. Just bored.
lines.zh: : 哪有。就是闲得慌。

lines.en: : Thought I’d come see Uta since I didn’t have anything else to do tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚没别的事，就想着来看看 Uta。

lines.en: : You’re here for the same reason, I guess?
lines.zh: : 我猜您也是为了同一个原因来的吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I think I’m starting to develop a bit of a maid addiction.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我觉得自己有点开始对女仆上瘾了。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive13
: Really? You don’t seem like the type who would be into that...cutesy sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？看您不像是会好那口……那种卖萌风格的人。

lines.en: : You don’t either but...here we are.
lines.zh: : 你看着也不像，不过……我们不还是来了。

lines.en: : A maid cafe is actually on the list of places I’d least expect to see you given your apparent distaste for girls.
lines.zh: : 考虑到你明显不太喜欢女孩子，女仆咖啡厅其实是我最想不到会遇见你的地方之一。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive12
: I wasn’t planning on staying long. Was just going to eat and then probably go out for a walk or something.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没打算待太久。就打算吃点东西，然后大概出去散个步什么的。

lines.en: : I think Uta said something about needing my help, too, but I have no idea what it’s about.
lines.zh: : Uta 好像也提过需要我帮忙，不过我完全不知道是要帮什么。

lines.en: : I think I do.
lines.zh: : 我大概知道。

lines.en: : She’s training a new girl and I think she wants us to be her first test subjects.
lines.zh: : 她在带一个新人，我猜她想让我们俩当那新人的第一批试验品。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive14
: Oh.
: Uhh...
: Want to order for me?
lines.zh: : 您能替我点吗？

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Have you ever dealt with an inexperienced employee before? It’s awkward and uncomfortable and I already have a hard time dealing with Uta’s fake maid personality.
lines.zh: : 您有没有应付过新手店员？又尴尬又难受，而且光是应付 Uta 那套假惺惺的女仆人格就已经够我受的了。

lines.en: : To be honest, she seems mostly the same to me.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得她基本没变。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. Hearing her call herself Uta-{i}chan{/i} makes me cringe harder than some crummy 80’s slasher film.
lines.zh: : 才不是。听她自称 Uta-{i}酱{/i}的时候，我尴尬得比看某部烂俗的八十年代砍杀片还难受。

lines.en: : Weird comparison but I think I get it.
lines.zh: : 这比喻挺怪的，不过我大概懂你意思。

lines.en: : Wait, already?! I thought I was just doing backroom stuff today?
lines.zh: : 等等，已经要上场了吗？！我还以为今天我只用在后厨干活呢？

lines.en: : You can’t hide from customers forever, Osako! The floor is where all the real money is!
lines.zh: : 你总不能躲客人躲一辈子吧，Osako！真正赚钱的地方可是大厅！

lines.en: scene utamaidfive15
: Osako?
lines.zh: : Osako？

lines.en: Isn’t that my karate instructor’s name?
lines.zh: 那不是我空手道教练的名字吗？

lines.en: : Someone you know?
lines.zh: : 您认识的人？

lines.en: : No way. The only person I know with that name is a total badass and would never work somewhere like this.
lines.zh: : 不可能。我认识的同名人可是个十足的狠角色，绝不可能在这种地方打工。

lines.en: : Uta-chan hidden technique...maid-push! Aaaaand-
lines.zh: : Uta 酱的隐藏技……女仆推！然后——

lines.en: : Why aren’t you moving?! I pushed you as hard as I could!
lines.zh: : 你怎么不动啊？！我已经使出吃奶的劲推了！

lines.en: : I didn’t even feel anything...
lines.zh: : 我压根什么都没感觉到……

lines.en: : No, really!
lines.zh: : 不，真的！

lines.en: : Are you wearing some sort of...vest?...Why the heck is your body so hard?
lines.zh: : 你是不是穿了什么……护甲？……你的身体怎么这么硬啊？

lines.en: : What is on you, Osako-chan?!
lines.zh: : 你身上到底有什么啊，Osako 酱？！

lines.en: : That’s just how my body is, okay?! There’s no need to touch me...
lines.zh: : 我身体本来就这样，行了吧？！别摸我了好吗……

lines.en: : I’ll go out there and try but...I still don’t have any idea what I’m doing and I-
lines.zh: : 我会出去试试的，可是……我还是完全不知道自己在干什么，而且我——

lines.en: : Well...
: Worried about the way you look?
lines.zh: : 是在担心自己的样子吗？

lines.en: : Don’t worry. The guy at your table’s a real go-getter and I’m sure he’ll think you’re beautiful.
lines.zh: : 别担心。您那桌的男的是个实打实的行动派，我敢肯定他会觉得您很漂亮。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive16
: Ooooh. A real go-getter, huh?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦。实打实的行动派，是吧？

lines.en: : I don’t go and get anything. It just comes to me with minimal effort.
lines.zh: : 我可没主动去争取什么。都是它们自己送上门来的，我几乎没费什么力气。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Likely story.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯。说得跟真的似的。

lines.en: : Try not to flirt too hard while you’re with another girl, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 当着另一个女孩的面，您可别调情调得太过火啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : And don't forget to order for me.
lines.zh: : 还有，别忘了替我点单。

lines.en: : Am I still doing that?
lines.zh: : 我还在干这个呢？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have it any other way.
lines.zh: : 我可不想换别人来。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive17
: Um...Good evening...Master...
lines.zh: : 呃……晚上好……Master……

lines.en: : Are you ready to...
lines.zh: : 请问您准备好……

lines.en: : Oh...you’ve gotta be kidding me.
lines.zh: : 哦……你不是在开玩笑吧。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive18
: Why? Why are you here?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你怎么会在这儿？

lines.en: : Hanging out with [high_school] girls during the afternoon isn’t enough, you need to do it at night, too?
lines.zh: : 白天跟[high_school]女生厮混还不够，晚上也得来？

lines.en: : I could be asking you the same question. Why are you even working here?
lines.zh: : 这句话我也可以问你。你为什么会在这儿打工？

lines.en: scene utamaidfive19
: Job security, okay? I still don’t have a guarantee in writing from that damn rich family that I’ll be keeping my instructor job, so I’m...weighing other options.
lines.zh: : 为了饭碗，行了吧？那该死的有钱人家到现在还没给我一份白纸黑字的保证，说我能继续当教练，所以我在……考虑别的出路。

lines.en: : And...a maid cafe was in that list of options?
lines.zh: : 然后……女仆咖啡厅也在那份备选清单里？

lines.en: scene utamaidfive20
: Yeah...I bet I look really out of place up here, huh?
lines.zh: : 是啊……我站在这儿肯定特别违和吧？

lines.en: : Wait, I didn’t mean it like that. I think you look-
lines.zh: : 等等，我不是那个意思。我觉得你看着——

lines.en: scene utamaidfive21
: Oof. Bad move, Master.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。失策了，Master。

lines.en: : Osako-chan was finally brave enough to come say hi to you and you cut her down just like that.
lines.zh: : Osako 酱好不容易鼓起勇气过来跟您打招呼，您就这么一句话把人家给否了。

lines.en: : For someone who spends so much time with girls, you really have no idea what to say to them, do you?
lines.zh: : 一个跟女孩子待了那么久的人，居然真的完全不知道该对她们说什么，是吧？

lines.en: scene utamaidfive22
: It’s fine. I spend so much time bossing this guy around that he’d probably greet me that way no matter how I looked.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我平时支使他支使得那么多，不管我什么样子，他大概都会这么跟我打招呼。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive23
: Bossing him around?!
lines.zh: : 支使他？！

lines.en: : Master is an M when I thought he was an S this whole time?!
lines.zh: : 我一直以为 Master 是 S，结果他居然是 M？！

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : I think she’s misinterpreting our relationship.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她是误会我们之间的关系了。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive24
: I believe she is. Sensei is clearly an S.
lines.zh: : 我也这么认为。Sensei 显然是个 S。

lines.en: : Io! I forgot you were even here!
lines.zh: : Io！我都忘了你还在呢！

lines.en: : What’s with all these letters?...
lines.zh: : 这些字母到底都是什么啊？……

lines.en: : I didn’t plan on joining in on this conversation, but I don’t mind fighting for Sensei’s honor when he is clearly not an M.
lines.zh: : 我本来没打算插嘴，不过既然 Sensei 明显不是 M，为他的名誉一战我也不介意。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive25
: Dude...are you really stringing along these ones, too?
lines.zh: : 喂……你还真把这几个也一起吊着啊？

lines.en: : Ayane alone isn’t enough?
lines.zh: : 光一个 Ayane 还不够？

lines.en: scene utamaidfive26
: Ah! So the girl in the bath was Ayane! I knew it!
lines.zh: : 啊！原来在浴室里的那个女孩是 Ayane！我就知道！

lines.en: : I need to add that to the list!
lines.zh: : 我得把这个记到名单上！

lines.en: : Please don’t add anyone to any list, Uta.
lines.zh: : 拜托你别把谁记到什么名单上，Uta。

lines.en: : You...{i}bathe{/i} with her too?
lines.zh: : 你还跟她一起{i}洗澡{/i}？

lines.en: : Does such a detail really surprise you at this point?
lines.zh: : 到了这个地步，这种细节真的还能让你惊讶吗？

lines.en: : Sure. As a bathhouse employee, I can confirm that there are plenty of co-ed family members that bathe together all the time.
lines.zh: : 当然。作为澡堂的员工，我可以确认，有很多家庭成员都是男女一起泡澡的，一直都是。

lines.en: : Granted, some of them have gotten up to some pretty raunchy stuff without realizing there are cameras, but not {i}all{/i} of them are like that.
lines.zh: : 诚然，其中有些人没意识到有摄像头，就干起了相当下流的事，不过也不是{i}所有{/i}人都那样。

lines.en: : Just...most.
lines.zh: : 只是……大部分而已。

lines.en: : Thanks, Io. That really helps.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Io。真是帮了大忙。

lines.en: : Really? Because it doesn’t sound like it would after hearing it out loud.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？这话我自己说出来听着，都不觉得能帮上什么忙。

lines.en: : I was being sarcastic...
lines.zh: : 我是在说反话……

lines.en: scene utamaidfive27
: Um...Uta? Can I go back into the kitchen now?
lines.zh: : 呃……Uta？我现在能回后厨了吗？

lines.en: : Huh? But you haven’t even taken their orders yet.
lines.zh: : 啊？可你还没给他们点单呢。

lines.en: : Are they still going to order after all of this? I would just leave if I were in their shoes.
lines.zh: : 闹成这样他们还要点单？换成我早就走了。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive28
: Io and I will both have whatever today’s special is.
lines.zh: : 我和 Io 都要今天的特餐。

lines.en: : Why are you ordering for Io?! Are you two dating now?!
lines.zh: : 您为什么要替 Io 点？！你们俩现在是在交往吗？！

lines.en: : What happened in the three minutes you were alone together?!
lines.zh: : 你们单独待了三分钟，到底发生了什么？！

lines.en: : What happened is I told him he could order for me. We’re not dating.
lines.zh: : 发生的事就是我跟他说可以替我点。我们没有在交往。

lines.en: : Really?! Cause you never know with this scoundrel!
lines.zh: : 真的？！跟这个混蛋可说不准啊！

lines.en: : Alright, so...I feel really awkward right now, but I heard your order and...I think that means my job is done.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那么……我现在尴尬得要死，不过我听到您点的东西了，而且……我觉得这意味着我的活儿干完了。

lines.en: : I’ll go tell the kitchen staff and...
lines.zh: : 我去跟后厨说一声，然后……

lines.en: scene utamaidfive29
: If you could...not tell anyone else in the dojo about me working here on the side, that would be kind of awesome.
lines.zh: : 如果您能……别跟道场里的其他人说我在这里兼职，那就太好了。

lines.en: : Deal. As long as you don’t tell Ayane you saw {i}me{/i} here either. She gets jealous pretty easily.
lines.zh: : 成交。只要你也别跟 Ayane 说你在这儿看见了{i}我{/i}。她挺容易吃醋的。

lines.en: : Consider it done.
lines.zh: : 一言为定。

lines.en: : Yes. {i}Consider it done{/i}, indeed.
lines.zh: : 是啊。{i}一言为定{/i}，当真如此呢。

lines.en: : Do you even know what we’re talking about, Uta?
lines.zh: : 你到底知不知道我们在说什么啊，Uta？

lines.en: : No. I’m too busy scowling at you.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我正忙着瞪您呢。

lines.en: : Does it look intimidating? Do you {i}fear{/i} Uta-chan?
lines.zh: : 看起来吓人吗？您{i}害怕{/i}Uta 酱了吗？

lines.en: : I'm utterly terrified.
lines.zh: : 我怕得要死。

lines.en: scene utamaidfive30
: Hey, I don’t work here so correct me if I’m wrong, but...
lines.zh: : 话说，我不在这儿上班，如果说错了请纠正我，不过……

lines.en: : Don’t you two need to, you know, get back to work?
lines.zh: : 你们俩是不是该，呃，回去干活了？

lines.en: : There’s a huge line of people at the door right now.
lines.zh: : 现在门口排了老长一队人呢。

lines.en: : Ah! Osako-chan! Retreat!
lines.zh: : 啊！Osako 酱！撤退！

lines.en: : If we’re quick enough, they might think this is just a normal restaurant and not a maid cafe!
lines.zh: : 只要我们够快，他们搞不好会以为这只是一家普通餐厅，而不是女仆咖啡厅！

lines.en: : Uhh...no. I think they’re all pretty sure this is a maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。我觉得他们都很确定这就是家女仆咖啡厅。

lines.en: : Either way! Run! Now!
lines.zh: : 不管了！快跑！现在！

lines.en: scene black
Uta grabs Osako by the sleeve and pulls her into the back room.
lines.zh: Uta 一把揪住 Osako 的袖子，把她拽进了后场。

lines.en: Roughly thirty seconds later, Uta is pushed back out onto the floor by someone who I imagine is her supervisor and proceeds to handle everyone all on her own.
lines.zh: 大约三十秒后，Uta 又被一个我猜是她上司的人推回了大厅，然后独自一个人应付起了所有客人。

lines.en: That poor girl.
lines.zh: 那姑娘真可怜。

lines.en: Customer service really seems rough- especially in a place like this.
lines.zh: 干服务业看起来是真辛苦——尤其是在这种地方。

lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]！{/i}
